facts.fact: Decree 2024-1911 of the President (published 2024-11-13) cites law no. 2014-024 of 10 December 2014 on electronic transactions and law no. 2014-025 of 10 December 2014 on electronic signature as the legal basis it is made under, and its Article 10 gives documents signed through a certified electronic signature device the same recognition as paper.
facts.system: Loi n°2014-024 sur les transactions électroniques
